tasks.title: Bug Fix: Streak Records Calculation Inconsistency
tasks.description: Fix incorrect streak record values in habit details screen (e.g., showing '104 days' and '5 days' incorrectly)
tasks.details:
ROOT CAUSE: The frontend calculateStreakRecords() function in InsightsSection.tsx uses Math.round() without time normalization, while the backend streakUtils.ts uses Math.floor() with proper midnight normalization. This causes off-by-one errors and timezone-dependent miscalculations.

SOLUTION:
1. Refactor calculateStreakRecords() in src/components/InsightsSection/InsightsSection.tsx (lines 116-200)
2. Replace Math.round() with Math.floor() for date difference calculation (lines 137-139)
3. Normalize dates to midnight using setHours(0, 0, 0, 0) before comparison
4. Append 'T00:00:00' to date strings when creating Date objects for consistent timezone handling
5. Match the backend differenceInDays() function pattern from convex/streakUtils.ts (lines 12-22)

SPEC: docs/specs/habit-details-screen/streak-records-calculation-bug-fix.md
tasks.testStrategy: Test single continuous streak displays correctly, verify separate streaks show as distinct records, test timezone edge cases (completion at 11:59 PM), verify current streak matches record when applicable, test backfill scenarios, compare frontend and backend calculations for consistency

subtasks.details: Add function that normalizes dates to midnight using setHours(0, 0, 0, 0), calculates millisecond difference, and uses Math.floor() instead of Math.round(). This ensures consistent date calculations.

subtasks.description: Update date string parsing to use 'T00:00:00' suffix for consistent timezone handling

tasks.title: Bug Fix: Personal Bests Calculation Shows Wrong Streak Values
tasks.description: Fix incorrect streak values in Personal Bests card (e.g., showing '104 days' when actual best is 5 days)
tasks.details:
ROOT CAUSE: The ProgressSection/utils.ts has a DUPLICATE calculateStreakRecords() function that still uses the buggy Math.round() and toISOString() logic, separate from the fixed version in InsightsSection.tsx.

The bugs:
1. toISOString() converts to UTC, shifting dates incorrectly
2. Math.round() instead of Math.floor() causes off-by-one errors
3. Date parsing without 'T00:00:00' suffix causes timezone issues
4. This makes separate streaks merge into one giant phantom streak

SOLUTION:
1. Import {differenceInDays, getTodayString, formatDateString} from '../../utils/dateUtils'
2. Replace all toISOString().split('T')[0] calls with formatDateString() or getTodayString()
3. Replace Math.round() date diff with differenceInDays() utility

SPEC: docs/specs/habit-details-screen/personal-bests-calculation-bug-fix.md

subtasks.title: Comprehensive Testing Suite

tasks.title: Fix StrengthProgressBar Empty Animation Bug
tasks.description: Remove the fill/bounce animation that occurs when the strength value drops to 0%. The spring animation causes visual overshoot making the bar appear to fill before emptying.
tasks.details: In StrengthProgressBar.tsx, the progressWidth animation uses withSpring() with damping:15 and stiffness:100. When transitioning to 0%, this causes the bar to visually 'bounce' and appear to fill before emptying. Replace spring with timing animation when transitioning to low values (<=5%). See spec: docs/specs/habit-card-screen/strength-progress-bar-empty-animation-fix.md
tasks.testStrategy: Build strength to 20%+, then skip days to decay to 0%. Verify bar animates smoothly down without bouncing or filling. Test normal animations still work when strength increases. Verify reduce motion accessibility setting is respected.

tasks.title: Enhance Template Card Animations in Import Habits Screen
tasks.description: Add polished, delightful animations to template cards including staggered entrances, improved press feedback, and success celebrations
tasks.details: Implement comprehensive animation improvements for the Import Habits screen: 1) Add staggered SlideInRight entrance for MiniTemplateCards when category expands (50ms delay per card), 2) Add icon bounce animation on category header expansion, 3) Enhance press feedback with rotation + shadow lift effect, 4) Add subtle idle pulse animation to Import button, 5) Add success checkmark animation after import with glow effect, 6) Add shimmer effect to Research badge, 7) Ensure all animations respect useReducedMotion accessibility settings. Files to modify: src/components/CollapsibleCategorySection.tsx, src/components/MiniTemplateCard.tsx, src/components/TemplateCard.tsx. Reference spec: docs/specs/import-habits-screen/template-card-animations.md
tasks.testStrategy: Test staggered animations with 10+ templates per category. Verify press feedback feels tactile and responsive. Test import success animation completes smoothly. Validate all animations disabled when useReducedMotion returns true. Test performance on low-end devices. Verify no layout shifts during animations.

subtasks.title: Fix Animation Lag and Performance Issues

tasks.title: Fix Template Preview Modal Sizing - Content Not Fully Visible
tasks.description: The TemplatePreviewModal appears too small when clicking a template card, preventing users from seeing all content (preview, customization options, import button) without excessive scrolling.
tasks.details: The modal has conflicting maxHeight constraints (container: 90%, bottomSheet: 0.9 * SCREEN_HEIGHT) that limit the visible area. Fix by: 1) Remove maxHeight: '90%' from container style, 2) Add flexGrow: 1 to content style, 3) Add contentContainerStyle with flexGrow: 1 to ScrollView, 4) Apply safe area insets to footer, 5) Consider fullScreen variant fallback for small devices (< 700pt). See spec: docs/specs/import-habits-screen/template-preview-modal-sizing.md
tasks.testStrategy: Test on iPhone SE (small), iPhone 14 (standard), iPhone 15 Pro Max (large). Verify all content visible without excessive scrolling. Verify import button not cut off. Test keyboard avoidance when name input focused. Verify safe area handling for home indicator.
